lighten
音标：英 /'laɪt(ə)n/  美 /'laɪtn/
v. 减轻；发亮
短语：lighten up — 放松，不要生气
例句：She took one of the parcels from her father to lighten his load.
她从父亲那儿拿过一个包以减轻他的负担。
例句：This will lighten your spirit and give you strength and motivation.
这样会减轻你的精神压力并会给你能力和动力。
例句：I told you at the beginning of this article that I needed to lighten up my bike without sacrificing my suspension.

lighter
音标：英 /'laɪtə/  美 /'laɪtɚ/
n. 打火机；驳船；点火者
v. 驳运
adj. 明亮的；光明的；照明好的；光线充足的
短语：cigarette lighter — 香烟打火机
例句：He immediately snapped his lighter to light her cigarette.
他啪的一声急忙打着他的打火机，给她的香烟点着了。

lighthouse
音标：英 /'laɪthaʊs/  美 /'laɪthaʊs/
n. 灯塔
例句：Hundreds of moths flew against the lighthouse windows.
数以千计的飞蛾扑向灯塔的窗子。
例句：The land on which the lighthouse stands has been in the Newman family for generations.
纽曼家族拥有包括灯塔在内的这片土地，传到现在已经有好几代了。
例句：On our last day, the hotel manager gave me a map of the island, marking the old church, the lighthouse and a pirate cemetery.
在我们离开的那天，酒店的经理送给我们一张地图，上面标注了这里古老的教堂、灯塔和海盗公墓。
